representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape = many/high-temporal/high-volatility metric stream, monitor job. Implementation is a 48-metric (6 services x 8, source/index.html:233-288) status tile wall with live value + delta + sparkline + status encoding (index.html:79-107, 431-466), a timestamped change-event stream rail (index.html:623-665), and a trace inspector with threshold lines and change-point annotations (index.html:554-606). Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show this representation populated at first frame. Direct match to the shape bundle and to object_type 'metric'.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by the monitor surface: metric wall fills ~80% of width, status filter chips with live counts and the 变化事件流 rail occupy the permanent top/right zones (screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900; index.html:164-207). Scanning metric status/change requires no mode switch.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy on the initial screenshots: brand+subtitle 'PULSEWALL 易变指标监控' plus cell tag (top bar), tile = name + big value + unit + direction delta + sparkline, rail rows carry verbs 升至警告/恢复正常/突跳 with from→to values and HH:MM:SS timestamps. What/where is conveyable within a glance in both viewports.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen, no routes/modals. Any metric's trace opens in 1 interaction: tile click (index.html:424), event-row click (index.html:634), keyboard arrows + button activation (index.html:698-709), or '/' to focus search (index.html:690-692). Inspector renders in-place in the fixed right column (index.html:183, 514-526).

context_loss.evidence: Primary actions preserve context: selection toggles the side inspector without leaving the wall (index.html:514-526); filters/search hide/show tiles via display, never rebuilding structure (index.html:493-509); rail prepend preserves scrollTop (index.html:639-647); Esc closes selection/search (index.html:693-697). Wall and rail stay visible while inspecting.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = topbar (4 status chips, search, pause, stream clock — index.html:164-177), wall, event rail; inspector is hidden until selection (index.html:183 'hidden'). Every control serves the monitor/trace job (pause for volatility, clock for data time, counts for triage); no decorative surfaces in either screenshot.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (4 of 7 checks). Consistent with source: 9.5-11px type on badges/svc tags/timestamps (index.html:99, 91, 132), low-contrast grays (--text-3 #5d6b7a, index.html:11), and mouse-only clickable <li> rail rows without keyboard focus (index.html:626-638). Positive affordances exist — focus-visible ring (index.html:87), aria-pressed chips (index.html:52, 170-173), aria-labels (index.html:175-176, 183), arrow-key grid nav (index.html:698-709) — which keep this above 1.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass, and both viewports render cleanly. But 4 of 7 receipt checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) implying CSS/ARIA rework, and a functional defect implies JS rework: persistent seed incidents set remaining=1e9 (index.html:349) so the per-tick approach step v += (inc.target - v)/inc.remaining (index.html:322) is ~0 — the intended first-screen anomalies (index.html:363 '首屏常态异常（耐久可见）') never materialize.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' is explicitly engineered: traceability via rail rows with from→to + time (index.html:626-638; visible in both screenshots), per-metric event list 新→旧 (index.html:541-549), chart change-point dots + threshold lines + hover readout (index.html:570-616), FLIP transform-only reorder '无布局抖动' (index.html:468-490). No-flicker via display-toggle filtering without rebuild (index.html:492-509), scrollTop-preserving prepend (index.html:645), tabular-nums. Seed history pre-generated synchronously so first frame is ready per brief constraint (index.html:159, 362-386).

defects_observed: Persistent first-screen anomalies never materialize: startIncident persistent branch sets remaining=1e9 (source/index.html:349), making the approach step (inc.target - v)/inc.remaining (source/index.html:322) effectively zero; screenshots confirm chips 严重 0 / 警告 0 / 正常 48 and zero warn/crit badges or colored left borders at capture, contradicting the stated intent '首屏常态异常（耐久可见）' (source/index.html:363) and weakening the brief's '异常在扫视内发现' success criterion at t=0 (live incidents only begin ~8 ticks after load, index.html:351-359).

Four of seven receipt checks fail — a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — matching small low-contrast type (9.5-11px badge/svc/timestamp text, source/index.html:99,91,132) and low-contrast gray tokens (source/index.html:11).
Event-rail rows are clickable <li> elements with no keyboard focus/activation path (source/index.html:626-638), consistent with the focus_order failure.
Initial screen contains no anomalous metric to monitor at the captured moment; all 48 tiles render in normal state in both viewports.

scores.overall_note: The package is a competent, tightly-scoped monitoring wall whose representation directly matches the brief's high-temporal/high-density volatile-metric stream: a 48-metric status tile wall with sparklines and status encoding, a permanent timestamped change-event rail, and an in-place trace inspector with threshold lines, change-point annotations and hover readout, all reachable in one click/keypress with context preserved (single screen, non-destructive filters, FLIP reorder, scrollTop-preserving prepend). Both screenshots render cleanly at 1280x860 and 1440x900 with the three layout checks passing, and the acceptance seed (traceable changes, no flicker noise) is addressed both structurally in source and visibly in the populated event rail. The main evidence-backed defects are: (1) the intended persistent first-screen anomalies cannot occur because the persistent-incident branch divides the approach step by 1e9 (source/index.html:349,322), leaving the captured initial screen entirely normal (严重 0/警告 0/正常 48) and undercutting the brief's at-a-glance anomaly success criterion at load; and (2) four of seven receipt checks fail on accessibility (contrast, focus order, target size, min projected size), consistent with 9.5-11px low-contrast text and mouse-only rail rows, though keyboard nav, focus-visible styles and aria attributes are present. Model preference is not human preference; task time, retrieval accuracy, and preference are not observable in this blind pilot.
